svg.title: LP2-14 ordinary rune spacing: original-image line gaps
svg.desc: Two unresized lossless crops of decoded original JPEG pixels, rendered at the same scale. Shading covers only the measured gap; ink-edge guides and caliper labels sit outside the text. Numbers are inactive-row counts inside the checked horizontal strip, threshold 160, with one-based line references.

g.text: Pixel counts are not decoded symbols.
